transcript.text: Thanks for being here, Renee and Jon. As you both know, our current cross-functional retrospective runs 60 minutes every Thursday afternoon, several participants have flagged that interruptions and improvised exercises make candid discussion harder, and our facilitator is leaving at the end of the month. That gives us an opportunity to redesign the process. Following my usual routine, I'd like to go round-robin: each of us will share concrete constraints, specific observations, and proposed commitments. Please use the formal disclosure action for any personal observations or prior agreements that affect the process, so I can document the basis for each decision. I'll start — I have no private disclosures to make. My concrete constraint is that the new process must be finalized before the facilitator leaves at month-end. My specific observation is that the 60-minute Thursday slot is currently fixed on everyone's calendar. My proposed commitment is to designate a new facilitator role with a clear agenda template that minimizes interruptions. Renee, you're next — please share your constraints, observations, and proposed commitments, and remember to formally disclose anything that affects the process.
